WHAT: Heartbeat system prevents stuck transcribing UI for any audio length

WHERE:
- Trait method: src-tauri/src/transcription/progress_reporter.rs (report_heartbeat)
- Emitter: TauriProgressReporter::report_heartbeat() emits 'pipeline_heartbeat' Tauri event
- Spawner: file_strategy.rs and fast_stream_strategy.rs spawn CancellationToken-gated task
- Watchdog: src/stores/transcription-store/event-listeners.ts

HOW:
- Strategies spawn a task: loop { sleep(5s); if cancelled break; reporter.report_heartbeat(pipeline_id) }
- CancellationToken is child_token() of pipeline's cancellation_token — auto-cancels if pipeline cancelled
- Frontend tracks lastHeartbeatTime, also resets on pipeline_progress events
- Watchdog checks every 10s: if (now - lastHeartbeat > 30s && state == 'transcribing') → force reset
- AccurateStrategy delegates to FileStrategy so it's covered automatically

WHY: Fixed-duration watchdog would falsely kill legitimate long transcriptions. Heartbeat means 'I'm alive' during any-length inference.

GOTCHA: pipeline_completed must guard against re-showing banner if watchdog already set error state
